title: Baby Pink Kurta Set for Baby Showers and Daytime Events
excerpt: How to style a baby pink embroidered kurta set for baby showers, brunches and daytime events, for guests and mums-to-be, with jewellery tips.
body:
A baby pink embroidered kurta set is a sweet, easy choice for a baby shower, godh bharai, brunch or any daytime event: wear it with pearl studs, thin bangles and ballet flats or juttis, and add a light dupatta if you want a more traditional look. Soft pink feels joyful and fresh in daylight, and embroidered cotton keeps you comfortable through long afternoons.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. This set is embroidered and stitched in our own Jaipur unit.*

**Quick answer**

- Baby shower guest: the set with pearls, thin bangles and juttis
- Mum-to-be: a custom fit to your current measurements, flat shoes
- Brunch: the set with small hoops, sunglasses and ballet flats
- Day wedding or haldi: add a light dupatta and gold jhumkas
- Winter: a cream or camel coat and thermal leggings

## Why is baby pink perfect for baby showers?

Baby pink is gentle, joyful and fresh, which suits the happy, daytime feel of a baby shower. It photographs beautifully in natural light and looks lovely next to flowers, balloons and pastel decor.

The [baby pink embroidered cotton kurta pant set with bird motif and tassels](/products/baby-pink-bird-embroidered-cotton-kurta-pant-set/) adds playful details. The bird motif feels light-hearted and the tassels bring movement, while cotton keeps you cool and comfortable for a long afternoon.

## How do I style it as a guest?

As a guest at a baby shower or godh bharai, aim for pretty and comfortable. Wear the set with pearl studs or small gold earrings, a few thin bangles and juttis or ballet flats. Keep makeup soft: a pink lip and a little blush.

If the event is more traditional, add a light dupatta from your wardrobe in cream, gold or a soft contrast like mint. Drape it over both shoulders or loosely around your neck.

| Event | Jewellery | Dupatta | Shoes | Makeup |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Baby shower or godh bharai | Pearls, thin bangles | Optional, light cream or gold | Juttis, ballet flats | Pink lip, soft blush |
| Brunch | Small hoops | None | Ballet flats, sandals | Tinted balm |
| Day wedding or haldi | Gold jhumkas | Light contrast dupatta | Embellished juttis | Bindi, kajal |
| Office festive day | Studs, a watch | None | Loafers | Light makeup |
| Garden party | Floral earrings | Optional | Wedges | Coral lip |

## Can a mum-to-be wear this set?

Yes. If you are the mum-to-be, comfort comes first. Our free custom fit lets you share your current bust, waist, hip and height, so the set is stitched for your body as it is now. Pair it with flat shoes and keep jewellery light.

Our [custom fit](/custom-stitched-indian-suits-made-to-measure/) page explains how it works.

For more ideas, our post on [what to wear to an Indian wedding when pregnant](/blog/what-to-wear-to-an-indian-wedding-when-pregnant/) covers comfortable silhouettes and fabric choices.

## How do I wear it to brunch or a day out?

Baby pink is lovely for a Sunday brunch, a garden party or a gallery visit. Skip the dupatta and wear the set on its own. Small gold hoops, sunglasses and ballet flats or sandals keep it relaxed. A woven tote or a small crossbody bag completes the look.

Our guide to [pastel kurta sets for day events](/blog/pastel-kurta-sets-for-day-events-white-peach-grey/) shows how soft shades work across the year.

## How do I wear it to a day wedding or haldi?

For a haldi or a morning wedding function, add a light dupatta in a contrast colour, such as mint, gold or cream. Gold jhumkas, a bindi and kajal make it more festive. Flowers in a braid look lovely.

For more haldi ideas, see [haldi outfit ideas for guests](/blog/haldi-outfit-ideas-for-guests/).

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Tassels move softly as you walk and add a little playfulness to photos. Thread embroidery on cotton is soft against the skin and does not scratch, which matters when you are sitting for a long ceremony or holding a baby.

## How do I wear it in winter?

In the UK, Canada or the northern USA, baby pink works in winter with soft neutral layers. Wear thin thermal leggings under the pants. On top, a cream, camel or soft grey coat looks lovely against pink. Change into juttis indoors.

## What else pairs well with this set?

If you like soft daytime colours, the [mint green hand block print cotton kurta set with hand work yoke](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) is another fresh option for baby showers.

For a slightly dressier pastel, the [peach pink embroidered cotton kurta set with cutwork organza dupatta](/products/peach-pink-embroidered-cotton-flex-kurta-pant-organza-dupatta-set/) comes with its own dupatta.

## How do I order the right fit?

Made-to-measure takes 5–7 working days, plus about 5–10 business days for delivery, so order 3–4 weeks before the event. Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days. We send photos of your piece being made before it ships, and shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia is free and duties-paid.

## Our pick for you

The [baby pink embroidered kurta set with bird motif](/products/baby-pink-bird-embroidered-cotton-kurta-pant-set/) is a happy, easy pick for baby showers and daytime events. A small etiquette note: at a baby shower, let the mum-to-be be the star, and keep your look soft.

## Frequently asked questions

**What should I wear to an Indian baby shower as a guest?**
A soft pastel kurta set, such as baby pink, peach or mint, with light jewellery and comfortable shoes is a lovely choice.

**Does this kurta set come with a dupatta?**
It is a kurta and pant set. You can add a light dupatta from your wardrobe in cream, gold or mint for a more traditional look.

**Can I wear baby pink to a day wedding?**
Yes. Add a light contrast dupatta, gold jhumkas and a bindi to make it festive for haldi or morning functions.

**How do I wash an embroidered cotton kurta set?**
Hand wash in cold water with a mild detergent, or use a gentle cycle in a laundry bag. Dry in the shade and iron inside out.
